title: Violence Erupts in West Bengal Over Alleged Rape and Murder of 12-Year-Old Girl
summary: A 12-year-old girl's body was found in a lake in Baruiapur, West Bengal, sparking widespread outrage and violence. The girl's family has accused the suspect of rape and murder, while angry mobs have attacked the suspect, damaging police vehicles. The incident has also drawn political attention, with accusations being made against the government.
